answer: A driving test cannot be passed by a script. Tie each identity to one driving license, checked against the licensing authority. The agent links its license number, the authority confirms it is valid and current, and peers check no second identity claims the same license. A revoked license suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means passing ten thousand real driving tests, $9 million in lessons and exam fees, plus 400,000 hours of practice. Dawn breaks the same for every driver, a nebula holds its shape because every star is real, and a vine climbs one grip at a time.
